notes.title: 2023-7-22：Optimization of Some Enemy Behaviors and Actions
2023-7-22：System optimization
notes.notes:
·Now can directly view the introduction of equipment without having to first equip it
·Relaxed the tp limit for player actions
·Added markers to the mini map
·Fixed some enemies with missing health bars

notes.title: 2023-7-22：Simplify functionality and fix issues
notes.notes:
·Simplified interaction with ladders
·The center of the screen is no longer obstructed

notes.title: 2023-7-22：Level adjustment
notes.notes:
·Reduced the aggressiveness of Man Slayer and Erosion Shadows
·Reduced the traps and enemy strength of the Long Night Forest
·Enhanced player protection from attacks
·Reduced Heal CD

notes.title: 2023-7-21：Patches for controllers and other details
notes.notes:
·Optimize controller functionality
·Optimize some UI logic
·Optimize some audio details
·Players will not reduce TP value when not in contact with enemies

notes.notes:
